最悪元夫が隣に引っ越してきたその日から

description:
Yuri was enjoying a happy newlywed life with her husband Naoto, a university lecturer, until she fell into a trap set by her ex-husband Souichi and his wife Saya.

Falsely accused of a sexual crime, Naoto tragically lost his life in a traffic accident before he could clear his name, leaving Yuri devastated.

Just when she had fallen into despair, Kousuke, a friend of Naoto's and a member of a wealthy conglomerate family, appeared and began helping her.

Yuri eventually discovers a shocking truth: Naoto had discovered a new species of winter firefly on Mount Tentai, and Souichi and his accomplices had been plotting to get rid of him so they could push ahead with their plans to develop the mountain.
